changelog:
What's new in v5.0.9:
• Online Orders (Beta): Receive website orders, manage online/WhatsApp/local jobs in a unified dashboard, review print settings and synchronize status with recovery after reconnection.
• WhatsApp Image Receipts: Redesigned digital payment receipts and Ready for Collection cards, clearer payment breakdowns and optional customer profile pictures.
• Printing: Improved black-and-white PDF output, job cancellation, tray selection and progress indicators.
• Interface: Refreshed themes and better WhatsApp profile picture recovery.
Animated installer manual download: https://github.com/shashmithx/shanex-print-manager-releases/releases/download/V5.0.9/SHANEX-Print-Manager-Pro-Setup-5.0.9.exe
Clean installations only; legacy installer migration remains unverified.
